name: Backflip for Animals!
desc:
🥚 Welcome to Backflip for Animals!

How to Play:
🤸 Backflip to reach new biomes
🥚 Steal eggs from guardians
🐣 Hatch eggs to collect rare pets, some are mutated
💵 Earn money from your OP pets
🏃 Train on the treadmill to gain Speed
⬆️ Upgrade your treadmill and base

🎮 Playable on Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet!
